title: Minding your mitochondria | Dr. Terry Wahls | TEDxIowaCity
summary: Dr. Terry Wahls tells how she used diet to manage her multiple sclerosis and get out of a wheelchair, drawing on mitochondrial biology. TED flagged the talk as health advice based on personal narrative.
why: HN commenters point to it as a moving personal story that motivated dietary changes, though it is also cited as anecdotal evidence.

quote.text: I highly recommend the talk, it is both very informative and very moving.
